items.q: Then a Frenchman that had the prestige... Well, with the three of us, we went into a business.

ctx.x: So what I did was, I met a Russian that had a formula for making waterproofing. Then a Frenchman that had the prestige, being a Frenchman, he could establish anything in France that he wanted. Well, with the three of us, we went into a business. Now, before we went into this business, I want to show you something.
